then.text: How did the peace talks go? Rock solves most things. Except teeth.
A peace offering for the mods and rockers? Two sticks, then: one says MODS all the way through, one says ROCKERS. I made them years ago for a joke. Nobody bought them.
There you go. Tell them to share.

else.text: Still need the Ace Face to come round? He's on the end of the pier, admiring himself in his mirrors.
The words go in at the start, when the rock's a great hot lump the size of a pillow. Then we roll and stretch it until the letters are tiny. A single batch can make a thousand sticks.
Sugar, glucose, a drop of peppermint, and a lot of elbow. Want one? Pay at the counter.
